snippet.title: Feed the Forest - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4362170/Feed_The_Forest/

A short, innocent incremental forest-builder. Be a snail! Feed The Forest! Hire other snails! The Forest needs juice! Enjoy the sun! Buy lots of upgrades! Blood is a type of juice!
